title: Twice-Baked Yukon Golds with Crispy Peruvian Potato Fritters
description: Elevate your side dish game with these flavorful, crispy potato fritters and twice-baked Yukon golds. Perfect for any meal.
instructions: Pierce the potatoes with a fork a few times and bake for 45-60 minutes or until tender.
Scoop out the flesh and mash with a fork.
Add a splash of oil to the potatoes and mix to combine.
Transfer the potatoes to a baking dish and top with grated cheese (optional).
Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Crumble the fritters and fry in batches until crispy and golden brown.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
Serve the twice-baked potatoes with crispy fritters on top.
